description: SwiftUI Application source file for OpenClaw iOS app, including application delegate, notification handling, background tasks, and main app structure.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: UIApplication delegate managing background processing, notifications, and app lifecycle.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background tasks, notification delegate, and remote notifications registration.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful APNs registration and passes device token to model.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs error when APNs registration fails.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming silent push notifications and triggers app model wake handling.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background wake when scene changes to background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers background refresh task with system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background wake refresh request with a delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Performs background refresh logic, reschedules next wake, and updates app model.

methods.name: isWatchPromptNotification(_:)
methods.description: Checks if notification payload matches watch prompt notification type.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction(from:)
methods.description: Parses user response to notification into a pending watch prompt action.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes parsed watch prompt action to app model for handling.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Processes user response to notification, particularly watch prompt actions.
